This is consistent with the area outage, so no changes are needed in your home right now. Service should return once the interruption is resolved.

Please confirm the camera has power, power-cycle it, then reconnect it to your current home network in the camera setup flow. If it still does not reconnect after that, please contact us for further assistance.

This can prevent websites from loading even while Wi-Fi remains connected. There is no active outage in your area. We’re escalating the DNS connectivity issue for further investigation.
